title: Nvidia close to investing $30 billion in OpenAI's funding round: source
title_zh: Nvidia 接近在 OpenAI 融资中投资 300 亿美元：来源
summary: STORY: Nvidia is reportedly close to finalizing a $30 billion investment in OpenAI.As the chipmaker moves to take a stake in one of its largest customers.That's according to a source speaking to Reuters.They said the investment is part of a fundraising round in which OpenAI is...
summary_zh: 故事：据报道，Nvidia 即将敲定对 OpenAI 的 300 亿美元投资。这家芯片制造商将入股其最大客户之一。据路透社报道，消息人士称。他们表示，这笔投资是 OpenAI 一轮融资的一部分。

title: Global shares climb as risk appetite holds firm, US-Iran tensions boost oil
title_zh: 由于风险偏好坚挺，全球股市上涨，美伊紧张局势提振油价
summary: By Niket Nishant and Tom Westbrook LONDON/SINGAPORE, Feb 20 (Reuters) - Global shares edged higher on Friday, brushing aside heightened tensions over a potential conflict between the United States and
summary_zh: 作者：Niket Nishant 和 Tom Westbrook 伦敦/新加坡，2 月 20 日（路透社）——周五全球股市小幅走高，忽略了因美国和印度之间潜在冲突而加剧的紧张局势。

title: Gold prices rise as investors eye US-Iran tensions
title_zh: 投资者关注美伊紧张局势，金价上涨
summary: Gold prices rose on Friday morning, as tensions between the US and Iran fuelled demand for safe haven assets.
summary_zh: 由于美国和伊朗之间的紧张局势刺激了对避险资产的需求，金价周五上午上涨。

title: UK records largest ever budget surplus in boost for Reeves ahead of spring forecast
title_zh: 英国创下有史以来最大的预算盈余，为里夫斯在春季预测之前提振
summary: The public sector recorded a surplus of £30.4bn in January, according to figures from the Office for National Statistics.
summary_zh: 英国国家统计局的数据显示，1 月份公共部门盈余为 304 亿英镑。

title: I want to return TM Lewin to its former glories, says CEO
title_zh: 首席执行官表示，我想让 TM Lewin 恢复昔日辉煌
summary: Heritage menswear retailer TM Lewin is back on the high street and growing under CEO Dan Ferris.
summary_zh: 传统男装零售商 TM Lewin 重返商业街，并在首席执行官 Dan Ferris 的领导下不断发展。

title: What crypto investors need to know about the UK's sandbox scheme
title_zh: 加密货币投资者需要了解英国沙盒计划的哪些信息
summary: The FCA's regulatory sandbox allows financial firms to test innovative products and services in a controlled environment.
summary_zh: FCA 的监管沙箱允许金融公司在受控环境中测试创新产品和服务。

title: Tesla cuts price of Cybertruck model Cyberbeast in US
title_zh: 特斯拉在美国下调 Cyber​​truck 车型 Cyber​​beast 的售价
summary: Feb 19 (Reuters) - Tesla has reduced the price of Cyberbeast, its most-expensive Cybertruck pickup truck model, to $99,990 from $114,990 in the United States, according to pricing information on the
summary_zh: 路透 2 月 19 日 - 根据定价信息显示，特斯拉已将其最昂贵的 Cyber​​truck 皮卡车型 Cyber​​beast 在美国的售价从 114,990 美元下调至 99,990 美元。

title: Tesla unveils cheaper Cybertruck variant, cuts Cyberbeast price to drive demand
title_zh: 特斯拉推出更便宜的 Cyber​​truck 版本，降低 Cyber​​beast 价格以推动需求
summary: Tesla unveiled a cheaper Cybertruck variant in the U.S. on Thursday and slashed ‌the price of its most-expensive model, Cyberbeast, as the electric-vehicle ‌maker struggles to find buyers for its pickup trucks.
summary_zh: 特斯拉周四在美国推出了一款更便宜的 Cyber​​truck 车型，并大幅削减了其最昂贵车型 Cyber​​beast 的价格，因为这家电动汽车制造商正在努力为其皮卡寻找买家。
